Plan

Roadmap

From the start of the grant on 1 Feb 2026 to the final delivery on 30 Nov 2026.

Today30 Nov 2026
FebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNov

Next Planned work

October 2026

  • Connect the escalation state machine to the Shield node, so that it drives ArduPilot's Brake, Loiter, RTL and Land modes. WP3
  • Configure ArduPilot's GeoFence (FENCE_ENABLE, FENCE_TYPE, FENCE_ACTION) as the last backstop behind the Shield. WP3
  • Run the VLA and the Shield on the Jetson Orin, with the simulators on the desktop (the grant's hil topology), and time the Shield there at the load the grant states its budget for (50 rules, 50 future poses per tick) against the 5 ms query budget. WP3 WP4
  • Policy layers (regulation, site, mission) and circle fences. WP1

October – November 2026

  • Perception rail: Project AirSim simulates the drone and its camera while ArduPilot SITL flies it through Project AirSim's ArduPilot controller, with the Shield in front of MAVROS 2. WP4
  • Mission Planner as the ground station, connected to the same ArduPilot over MAVLink through mavlink-router, next to MAVROS 2.
  • Fly OpenVLA with the rule summary in its prompt, and compare missions with the summary on and off. WP2
  • A stress harness that starts ArduPilot SITL sessions, changes rules mid-flight and collects each episode as a bundle with rosbag2. WP4
  • Mid-flight policy updates (a moving no-fly zone, a time-window switch, a corridor swap) through a REST endpoint. WP1

November 2026

  • KPI campaign: dynamic scenarios with at least 3 seeds each, on the hil topology and the delivered code. WP4
  • Per-paraphrase robustness, measured with a pilot that reads text. WP2 WP4
  • The KPI report on dynamic-scenario stress, per scenario family. WP4

After the hil runs

  • The same software on the drone's companion computer, next to the real ArduPilot autopilot (the grant's flight topology).

Final delivery, 30 Nov 2026

  • Policy DSL, Prefix Compiler, Safety Shield and Stress Testing complete
  • KPI report on dynamic-scenario stress
  • Perception-rail integration
  • Signed final report

Done Milestones reached

  • 6 Oct 2026 Fence index, typed rule summary, paraphraser, escalation state machine, signed bundles, stress profiles and a KPI report. WP1 WP2 WP3 WP4
  • 3 Oct 2026 The policy indicator on screen, and a no-fly zone in the city. WP3
  • 30 Sep 2026 Target identity and re-acquisition.
  • 29 Sep 2026 Control loop at 10 Hz, a city obstacle map, traffic signals and pedestrians. WP3
  • 22 Sep 2026 Follow missions in the CityLife city.
  • 8 Sep 2026 Replay bundles that re-derive their own KPIs. WP1 WP4
  • 28 Aug 2026 The Shield runs as a ROS 2 node on ArduPilot SITL with MAVROS 2, with the Shield on and off. WP3
  • 4 Aug 2026 A VLA (AerialVLA) and the Shield act in the same control ticks. WP3
  • Jul 2026 OpenVLA-7B flies through the Shield in simulation. WP3
